scripts.dev: npm run build -w @maglive/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend,media-worker --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @maglive/frontend" "npm run dev -w @maglive/backend" "npm run worker:media -w @maglive/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @maglive/contracts && npm run build -w @maglive/backend && npm run build -w @maglive/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @maglive/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
